routes.label: Count the dots in successive hexagonal bands

question:
Three hexagons of increasing size are shown below. Suppose the dot pattern continues so that each successive hexagon contains one more band of dots. How many dots are in the next hexagon?

[Figure 1](figures/2020_AMC_8_Q04_question_fig1.svg)
solution:
Count the center dot separately, then count the bands around it. The first band has \(6\) dots, the next has \(12\), and the new outer band will have \(18\).

To see why the new band has \(18\), follow its six sides around the hexagon. Count each side's starting corner but leave its ending corner for the next side. Each side then contributes \(3\) dots, so there are \(6\cdot3=18\) dots in that band, with no corner counted twice.

The next hexagon therefore contains

\[
1+6+12+18=\boxed{37}\text{ dots},
\]

choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\). Counting just the new band makes the growing pattern easier to track.
